column1: 23469§logical§ˈlɒdʒɪkl§The apartment's room arrangement was not logical.§公寓房间的格局不**合理**。§
23470§unpredictable§ˌʌnprɪˈdɪktəbl§Their major discovery illustrated how unpredictable consequences can come from rather modest beginnings.§他们的重要发现表明了貌似平常的初始是如何产生**预想不到**的结果的。§
23471§marvel§ˈmɑːvl§Visitors to the ancient temple often marvel at how its builders moved such huge stones without modern machines.§参观这座古庙的游客常常**惊叹**于建造者如何在没有现代机械的情况下搬运如此巨大的石块。§补例句
23472§rational§ˈræʃnəl§The boss made a rational decision in the end.§老板最终做出了**合理**的决定。§
23473§religious§rɪˈlɪdʒəs§The festival has deep religious roots, but today it is celebrated by people of all faiths and backgrounds.§这个节日有着深厚的**宗教**根源，但如今各种信仰和背景的人都会庆祝它。§补例句
23474§accustomed§əˈkʌstəmd§I'm not accustomed to using a gas stove.§我不**习惯**使用煤气炉。§
23475§collaborate§kəˈlæbəreɪt§I hope your department could collaborate with me on the new project.§我希望你们部门能够在新项目上**配合**我工作。§
23476§expenditure§ɪkˈspendɪtʃə(r)§In the face of the inflation, local government is also reducing expenditure.§面对通货膨胀，地方政府也在降低**支出**。§
23477§impartial§ɪmˈpɑːʃl§A judge must be fair and impartial to everybody.§法官必须公平**公正**地对待每一个人。§
23478§satisfaction§ˌsætɪsˈfækʃn§What he has done is far from satisfaction.§他所做的远不能令人**满意**。§
23479§operation§ˌɒpəˈreɪʃn§The rescue operation continued through the night as firefighters searched the collapsed building for survivors.§救援**行动**持续了一整夜，消防员在倒塌的大楼里搜寻幸存者。§补例句
23480§executive§ɪɡˈzekjətɪv§Kate, a former teacher, is now an executive for a charity.§凯特从前是一位教师，现在是一个慈善团体**管理者**。§
23481§increase§ɪnˈkriːs§The number of students choosing to study abroad has increased sharply over the past ten years.§过去十年里，选择出国留学的学生人数大幅**增长**。§补例句
23482§package§ˈpækɪdʒ§The packages were delivered to the wrong place.§这些**包裹**被送错地方了。§
23483§interweave§ˌɪntəˈwiːv§Do as I told you and interweave these two pieces of cloth together.§按我说的做，把这两块布**编织**在一起。§
23484§mimic§ˈmɪmɪk§People have always been fascinated by the parrot's ability to mimic human speech.§人们向来对鹦鹉**模仿**人类说话的能力惊叹不已。§
23485§collective§kəˈlektɪv§The decision, made by the board of directors, is the result of collective agreement.§董事会做出的决定是**集体**同意的结果。§
23486§relationship§rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp§Researchers have found a close relationship between the amount of sleep students get and their exam results.§研究人员发现，学生的睡眠时间与考试成绩之间有着密切的**关系**。§补例句
23487§scientific§ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk§This morning I want to tell you about a recent scientific discovery dealing with the relation between plants and animals.§今天上午我想告诉你们关于动植物关系的一项新近的**科学**发现。§
23488§mutate§mjuːˈteɪt§Scientists warn that the virus could mutate into a much deadlier form.§科学家们警告，该病毒可能**变异**成更致命的形式。§
23489§perceptual§pəˈseptʃuəl§The study shows that people's perceptual and filtering processes will create misunderstandings.§研究显示人们的**感知**和过滤过程会产生误解。§
23490§terms§tɜːmz§These food species are not just special in terms of appearance or taste.§这些食物品种不仅仅是在外观或味道**方面**有特别之处。§改译文：in terms of 原译「在…上」拆在两处括不出，改为「在…方面」
23491§regard§rɪˈɡɑːd§The department is reviewing its policy with regard to immunization.§该部门正在重新审查其**有关**免疫注射的政策。§
23492§motor§ˈməʊtə(r)§The small boat is powered by an electric motor, so it makes almost no noise on the lake.§这艘小船由电动**马达**驱动，所以在湖上几乎没有噪音。§补例句
23493§prevent§prɪˈvent§Washing your hands regularly is one of the simplest ways to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.§经常洗手是**阻止**传染病传播最简单的方法之一。§补例句
23494§master§ˈmɑːstə(r)§The exhibition displays more than fifty paintings by Dutch masters of the seventeenth century.§这次展览展出了五十多幅17世纪荷兰**大师**的画作。§补例句
23495§convict§kənˈvɪkt§The jury convicted the man, and he was sentenced to twenty years in prison.§陪审团给此人**定罪**，他被判入狱20年。§改译文：原译「宣告此人有罪」被「此人」隔开，括不出 convict（定罪），改为「给此人定罪」
23496§eradicate§ɪˈrædɪkeɪt§The campaign aims to eradicate illiteracy, which was also a part of basic education.§这个活动旨在**消除**文盲，这也是基础教育工作的一部分。§
23497§ingenious§ɪnˈdʒiːniəs§By such ingenious adaptations to specific pollinators, orchids have avoided the hazards of rampant crossbreeding in the wild.§通过**巧妙**地适应特定的传粉昆虫，兰花避免了在野外杂交泛滥的危险。§
23498§department§dɪˈpɑːtmənt§If you have any questions about your visa, please contact the international students department of the university.§如果你对签证有任何疑问，请联系大学的留学生**部门**。§补例句
23499§programme§ˈprəʊɡræm§They had a meeting to set up the programme.§他们开会启动了**项目**。§
23500§instruction§ɪnˈstrʌkʃn§The students must follow all instructions exactly.§学生必须准确遵守所有的**指示**。§
23501§communal§kəˈmjuːnl§Students living in the hall share a communal kitchen, where they often cook and eat together in the evenings.§住在宿舍楼里的学生共用一个**公共**厨房，晚上他们常在那里一起做饭吃饭。§补例句
23502§narrative§ˈnærətɪv§The novel's narrative moves back and forth between the present day and the narrator's childhood in Ireland.§这部小说的**叙述**在现今与叙述者在爱尔兰的童年之间来回切换。§补例句
23503§dependent§dɪˈpendənt§Many small island nations are heavily dependent on tourism, so a fall in visitors can damage their economies.§许多小岛国严重**依赖**旅游业，因此游客减少会损害它们的经济。§补例句
23504§spectacle§ˈspektəkl§The opening ceremony was a magnificent spectacle of music, dance and fireworks watched by millions around the world.§开幕式是一场由音乐、舞蹈和烟火组成的盛大**表演**，全世界有数百万人观看。§补例句
23505§psychological§ˌsaɪkəˈlɒdʒɪkl§Losing a job can have serious psychological effects, such as anxiety and low self-esteem.§失业可能带来严重的**心理**影响，比如焦虑和自卑。§补例句
23506§communicate§kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt§Good teachers communicate clearly with their students and encourage them to ask questions in class.§好老师会和学生清楚地**沟通**，并鼓励他们在课堂上提问。§补例句
23507§motif§məʊˈtiːf§The cloth was dyed with abstract plant and animal motifs.§那块布被染上了抽象的动植物**图案**。§
23508§outrage§ˈaʊtreɪdʒ§This murder provoked outrage across the country.§这起凶杀案在全国范围内激起了**愤慨**。§
23509§competitive§kəmˈpetətɪv§Tom is very competitive and always wants to finish first, even in friendly games with his classmates.§汤姆很**好胜**，即使是和同学玩友谊游戏也总想拿第一。§补例句
23510§protect§prəˈtekt§Wearing sunglasses can protect your eyes from the harmful ultraviolet rays of the sun.§戴太阳镜可以**保护**你的眼睛免受太阳有害紫外线的伤害。§补例句
23511§stray§streɪ§The little girl who strayed from home four days ago has not yet been found.§那个四天前从家**走失**的小女孩还没找到。§改例句：「从家走失」是 stray from home，漏了 from
23512§spontaneous§spɒnˈteɪniəs§When the singer appeared on stage, the crowd burst into spontaneous applause before she had sung a note.§歌手一出现在舞台上，还没开口唱，观众就**自发**地鼓起掌来。§补例句
23513§symbolic§sɪmˈbɒlɪk§Many paintings are rich in symbolic overtones.§许多画作富有**象征**寓意。§
23514§means§miːnz§Plants can defend themselves by using both physical and chemical means.§植物可以通过物理以及化学的**方法**保护自己。§
23515§temptation§tempˈteɪʃn§You should resist the temptation of the food.§你要抵制住食物的**诱惑**。§改例句：「食物的诱惑」是 the temptation of the food，to 用错
23516§struggle§ˈstrʌɡl§Millions of people are struggling for survival.§数百万人为了生存而**奋斗**。§
23517§devoid§dɪˈvɔɪd§The hot air was devoid of even the slightest amount of moisture.§热空气中**全无**一丝水分。§改译文：原译「热空气将最后一滴水分都蒸发掉了」没译出 devoid（全无的），改为「热空气中全无一丝水分」
23518§prospect§ˈprɒspekt§Mary is one of the best prospects for this position.§玛丽是这个职位最有希望的**候选人**之一。§
23519§intricate§ˈɪntrɪkət§A city is more intricate than a village.§城市比村庄更加**错综复杂**。§
23520§radical§ˈrædɪkl§Radical views will burn your fingers.§**激进**的观点会让你吃苦头的。§
23521§prone§prəʊn§Ross is prone to lose her temper when people disagree with her.§别人和罗斯意见一有不同，她就**容易**发脾气。§改译文：原译「就会发脾气」没译出 prone（易于…的），「会」改为「容易」
23522§strive§straɪv§We encourage all staff to strive for the highest standards.§我们鼓励所有员工为达到最高标准而**努力**。§
23523§dictate§dɪkˈteɪt§The manager dictated a letter to his secretary.§经理向他的秘书**口述**一封信函。§
23524§prosecute§ˈprɒsɪkjuːt§The man was prosecuted for murder.§这个人因谋杀罪而被**起诉**。§
23525§reflect§rɪˈflekt§They must reflect on their own political interest.§他们必须**仔细考虑**他们的政治利益。§
23526§triumph§ˈtraɪʌmf§I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.§我认为拥有勇气并不代表没有恐惧，而是**战胜**恐惧。§
23527§regulation§ˌreɡjuˈleɪʃn§Anyone who violates the regulations must be punished.§任何违反**规定**的人都要受到惩罚。§改例句：「任何人」是 anyone 一个词，Any one 拼写错
23528§liable§ˈlaɪəbl§He is liable to be punished as a violator.§他**可能**因为违规而受罚。§
23529§sort§sɔːt§David doesn't like the movie which is sort of boring.§大卫不喜欢这部**有点**无聊的电影。§
23530§proposition§ˌprɒpəˈzɪʃn§The proposition is so clear that it needs no explanation.§这个**论点**很明确，不需要解释。§改例句：「如此…以至于」是 so…that，very 用错
23531§stubborn§ˈstʌbən§Henry was too stubborn to admit what he did was wrong.§亨利太**顽固**，不承认自己做错了。§
23532§treasure§ˈtreʒə(r)§The man amassed great treasure during these years.§这个人在这些年里积累了大量的**金银财宝**。§
23533§confidential§ˌkɒnfɪˈdenʃl§The old man was accused of leaking national confidential information to foreign countries.§这个老头因为向国外泄露国家**机密**而被指控。§
23534§contingent§kənˈtɪndʒənt§Our plans for the weekend trip are contingent on the weather, so we will decide on Friday.§我们周末出游的计划**取决于**天气，所以星期五再作决定。§补例句
23535§statistical§stəˈtɪstɪkl§The company provides reliable statistical information about population and households for all parts of the country.§该公司为全国各个地区提供可靠的人口及家庭**统计**信息。§
23536§surrender§səˈrendə(r)§I'd rather make the gravest of mistakes than surrender my own judgment.§我宁可酿成大错，也不愿**放弃**自己的判断。§
23537§disabled§dɪsˈeɪbld§He got disabled during the war.§他在战争中落下了**残疾**。§
23538§masterpiece§ˈmɑːstəpiːs§The artist contributed all his life to the completion of a great masterpiece.§这位艺术家毕其一生来完成一部伟大的**杰作**。§改译文：原译「作品」不是 masterpiece（杰作）的意思，改为「杰作」
23539§solitary§ˈsɒlətri§After his wife died, the old man led a solitary life in a small cottage at the edge of the forest.§妻子去世后，老人在森林边的一间小屋里过着**孤独**的生活。§补例句
